_note: With `vitePreprocess()` and no `script: true`, a `<script lang="ts">` reaches the compiler as written and acorn-typescript parses it. It rejects a parameter modifier outside a method (`private` is a reserved word there), `using` declarations and a repeated type alias, reports an incompatible `static accessor` at the file offset equal to the modifier's column, and after an overload signature reads the rest of the script as if inside a plain function, so a top-level `await` fails. Interface merging, overloads and constructor parameter properties parse (the latter then fails TypeScript stripping). Verified against upstream svelte-check.
